::: {.bio}
Delphine PA Dang is a Vietnamese artist, musician and researcher based in Sydney. Her research-led artistic practice draws on data science and international relations, with particular interests in political theory, political thought and computational international relations. Working across sound, performance and moving image, she brings creative experimentation and academic inquiry into dialogue.

Her practice encompasses acting, songwriting and singing, alongside collaborative roles as a producer, assistant director and editor. She trained in opera for seven years, beginning her formal vocal training after receiving the Golden Buzzer on *Vietnam's Got Talent*. She also plays bass and has a background in ballet and theatre. These disciplines shape her approach to composition, presence and narrative across her artistic work.
:::
